title: No test script is defined in package scripts
reasoning: The project exposes lint/build/start scripts but no test command, which weakens release safety because automated verification cannot be consistently invoked by tooling.
recommendation: Add a `test` script and wire it to the project’s test runner (or a placeholder that fails until tests are implemented) so CI and contributors have a standard entrypoint.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests or test command are present in the provided files, so there is no mechanism shown that would enforce behavioral checks.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add CI to run `pnpm test` on pull requests and require it to pass before merge.
